notes: KG Triumph Scanner v0.3.7 Build 19 adds a direct captured-control status check. Connect in Read ECU / module data at 500 kbps, open Module reads and choose Read control status. The button sends seven exact raw queries repeatedly observed on the workshop bike's 604→602 and 592→594 routes. No manually entered route is required for this check. Disconnect the other diagnostic tool before using active reads.
